0.original: Charakha stares at you with admiration.

24.original: Use the Oroniri kumis on the designated locations.

48.original: Aha! I recognize you─you are the <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> that conquered Bardam's Mettle. You must be possessed of an inhuman strength.

49.original: Rare are the outsiders who win the respect of Azim's sons and daughters.

50.original: We must celebrate your triumph of this most arduous of trials the Oronir way: you are to perform a sacred ritual.

51.original: It is not complicated. All you must do to complete it is visit five stones in the area and sprinkle some kumis on them.

52.original: You are not to do this lightly, however. With each drop of liquid that hits the stone, you must think of a goal you wish to achieve and make a vow to yourself to attain it.

53.original: Once you are finished, come back to see me. Good luck!

54.original: Whatever you do, be sure to keep your goals at the forefronts of your mind as you sprinkle the kumis upon the stones─that is the most important part, after all.

55.original: You have finished the ritual, I take it? Very good. Then, please allow me to share with you the meaning behind this practice.

56.original: You see, the five stones upon which you poured the kumis are also referred to as the “fingers of Azim.” This ritual is a way of showing him our respect and allows us to receive his guidance.

57.original: If he deems our desire great enough, he will carve a path for us to achieve it. Though, that is not to say we can simply sit back and relax. We must also work hard to fulfill our dreams.

58.original: Father Azim sees all and hears all. Your wishes have reached him and, should he deem you worthy, he shall grant them unto you.
